title: Need graph v1
description: What a user of a subject needs, built from the subject's name and description only (dokimi.novelty.needs), frozen in a file so that `eval coverage` reads it instead of regenerating it. The graph `dokimi.novelty.needs.save_graph` writes is valid unstamped. `confirmed_by` says whether a person confirmed a node (`user`) or it is a model's guess (`hypothesis`, the default).

provenance.description: How the graph was made: model, prompt version, draws, and the coverage spread over the draws. Open: recorded, not interpreted.
